en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a damaged two‑story urban building with ornate window frames and wrought‑iron balconies. The façade is pockmarked with shell or bullet damage, and some upper windows and parts of the roof are destroyed. To the right is a rounded corner pavilion with decorative elements. A horse‑drawn carriage stands on the left, and a blurred figure in a hat walks on the dirt street in front of the building. The image has a white border like an old photographic postcard.
